children: Sydney, September 16, 2026-- Moody's Ratings has affirmed The GPT Group's A2/P-1 issuer rating and A2 senior unsecured ratings. We have also affirmed the A2 backed senior unsecured rating, A2 senior unsecured medium-term note program rating and the P-1 other short-term rating for GPT RE Limited. The outlook on all ratings remains stable.

title: Moody's Ratings affirms The GPT Group's ratings, outlook remains stable
